content: Design a billboard advertisement to promote a seasonal sale.

Headline: "Season’s Greetings! Winter Sale is Here!"

Sub headline: "Get the Best Deals of the Season"

Graphic: A snowflake, Christmas tree or cozy winter scene

Body copy:
- Save up to 50% off on everything you need for winter
- Shop our seasonal collection including winter coats, boots, sweaters, and accessories
- Warm up with our cozy home decor and holiday items
- Don't wait! Limited time only!

Call-to-action:
- Visit us in-store or online to start shopping today!
- Hurry and take advantage of these amazing deals before they’re gone!

Hey, I really like the design and the message behind the billboard. Could you also add some information about the types of payment methods accepted? It would be great to know if credit card payments are accepted.

Sure, here's an updated version of the billboard advertisement that includes information about payment methods:
